title: C¹ approximation of a real Lipschitz function on a closed ball (Simon 2.1.5, localized)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, K ∈ ℝ≥0 and f : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be K-Lipschitz. Then for every R ∈ ℝ and every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is g : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 g) such that Lⁿ(B_R(0) ∩ {x : f(x) ≠ g(x)}) < ε, where B_R(0) = closedBall 0 R and Lⁿ is Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ (R : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume (closedBall (0 : Rn n) R ∩ {x | f x ≠ g x}) < ε
